name: bm_go_board_useful
description: Reprofile Board.useful after a deeper-state warmup on the real bm_go board shape.
reprofile_warmup_expr: lambda: (lambda board=Board(), moves=[(0, 0), (1, 0), (0, 1), (2, 0), (2, 1), (1, 2)], probe=to_pos(1, 1): (all(board.move(to_pos(x, y)) is None for x, y in moves), sum(board.useful(probe) is None for _ in range(50000))))()
